blocks.text: Evaporation (bhaap ban kar urna) kisi bhi temperature par liquid ka khud ba khud (spontaneously) vapour mein badalna hai.

Jab zyada energy wale molecules liquid chhor dete hain aur kam energy wale peechhe reh jate hain, to liquid ka temperature gir jata hai. Phir aas paas (surroundings) se heat liquid ki taraf aati hai aur aas paas ka temperature bhi gir jata hai. Is se samajh aata hai ke evaporation thandak paida karti hai.

Nahane ke baad hawa lagne par jism se pani evaporate hota hai aur insan ko thandak mehsoos hoti hai: H₂O ke molecules jism ki energy le kar ur jate hain. Mitti ke bartan (earthenware, jaise matka) bhi isi wajah se pani thanda rakhte hain. Mitti ke bartan mein bareek surakh (pores) hote hain.

Jin pani ke molecules ke paas intermolecular forces torne jitni K.E ho, woh in surakhon se bahar aa kar evaporate ho jate hain. Yeh amal (process) chalta rehta hai aur is ke liye energy liquid se hi aati hai. Is liye baqi pani ke molecules ki ausat K.E kam hoti hai aur pani ka temperature gir jata hai. Isi liye matke ka pani thanda rehta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Evaporation mein sab se tez (zyada energy wale) molecules nikal jate hain, is liye peechhe rehne walon ki ausat energy, yani temperature, kam ho jata hai. Kitab ke aakhri jumle mein “Hens” chhapa hai, jis se murad “Hence” (is liye) hai.

blocks.prompt: Geele kapre hawa mein jaldi kyun sookhte hain aur pasina (sweat) jism ko thanda kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Hawa naye vapour ko door le jati hai, is liye evaporation tez hoti hai. Pasina evaporate hone ke liye energy jism se leta hai; tez molecules ur jate hain aur jism ki satah ka temperature gir jata hai.

items: Evaporation: kisi bhi temperature par liquid ka khud ba khud vapour banna; tez molecules nikal jate hain, baqi ki ausat K.E kam, is liye thandak (nahane ke baad jism, matka).
